summary: Releases the sub-object array referenced by this[77] (field 0x134). If the pointer is non-null, reads the element count from the dword 4 bytes before the array, iterates backward over count elements (316-byte stride) calling EmptyStub_0170 on each, then frees the allocation base via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Both branches zero the count field (this+0x130) and the pointer field (this+0x134). Returns 0.

operations.description: If this[77] (array pointer at field 0x134) is non-null, proceed with array release.
Read the element count from the dword at array_ptr minus 4 and compute the last element address as array_ptr plus count times 316.
Iterate backward over count elements, decrementing by the 316-byte stride and calling EmptyStub_0170 on each element.
Free the sub-object array allocation base (array_ptr minus 4) via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Zero the pointer field this+0x134 and the count field this+0x130 after releasing the array.
If this[77] is null, skip the array release and only zero the count and pointer fields.

unresolved: The element type (316-byte stride) and the meaning of the dword stored 4 bytes before the array are not evidenced by the packet.
EmptyStub_0170 is a decompiler-named stub; whether it performs per-element teardown is not evidenced by this function alone.
